cohort: 326 women with a unicornuate uterus and 326 age- and BMI-matched controls with no congenital uterine anomaly
finding: Women with a unicornuate uterus had a significantly lower live-birth rate and higher rates of miscarriage, ectopic pregnancy, preterm delivery, and Cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women with a unicornuate uterus had a significantly higher rate of Cesarean delivery compared to controls.
